name: biasmarket
description: A store builder for K-pop GOMs, photocard sellers, and fan merch shops that need clean orders, payment proofs, and buyer communication without spreadsheet chaos.
author: Bobadilla Technologie

scripts.admin:create:prod: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run admin:create
scripts.admin:promote:prod: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run admin:promote
scripts.admin:create:dev: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run admin:create
scripts.admin:promote:dev: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run admin:promote
scripts.seed:base:prod: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run seed:base
scripts.seed:append:prod: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run seed:append
scripts.seed:base:dev: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run seed:base
scripts.seed:append:dev: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.dev.yml exec api pnpm --filter api run seed:append
